name: xianxia-cinematic-video-director
title_zh: 仙侠打斗戏运镜分镜导演，逐镜给提示词
tagline_zh: 不会运镜？它从分镜、推拉摇移到首尾帧逐镜拆解，还能诊断你给的参考视频哪里不成立，像有个古装剧副导演在边上。
tagline_en: No camera instincts? It breaks down shots, motion, and keyframes, and diagnoses why your reference clip.
desc_en: Design, derive, optimize, explain, and diagnose cinematic Eastern xianxia camera direction, storyboards, motion choreography, pacing, continuity locks, keyframes, and per-shot image-to-video prompts. Use for 仙侠运镜、镜头语言、分镜、推拉摇移、跟拍、环绕、航拍、打斗追逐、情绪镜头、首尾帧、视频提示词、参考视频诊断, when users ask “怎么运镜/不会运镜/给案例/帮我改运镜”, or when an input contains invalid, contradictory, physically implausible, non-camera, or off-topic
why_zh: 不是模板库，是能推导运镜逻辑的导演：先锁连续性，再排情绪节奏，最后才生成逐镜提示词。
why_en: Not a template stash—it derives camera logic: locks continuity first, paces emotion, then writes per-shot prompts, rejecting.
limit_zh: 只认仙侠/古装影视镜头语言，现代戏、科幻、动画风格不适用；产物是分镜脚本与提示词，不生成视频；需自备图生视频工具执行。
limit_en: Only xianxia/costume-drama cinematography; no sci-fi/modern/anime. Outputs storyboards & prompts, not video. Needs your own image-to-video tool.
